newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen to run steel venture with Krupp.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen to run steel venture with Krupp.

text.p: Germany's Thyssen AG said it would assume executive control of a steel joint venture it plans to found with Krupp, which on Monday withdrew a hostile takeover bid.
A Thyssen spokesman said that a joint steel venture between the two companies would offer the best solution for both workers and shareholders.
Thyssen to run steel venture with Krupp
The spokesman added that the leading role of Thyssen in the venture stemmed from its larger production capacity and the stronger earnings at its Thyssen Stahl AG unit.

"Now we have the time and calm to work out the details," the spokesman said. The two companies announced earlier that Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp had abandoned its hostile takeover and would not relaunch one in future.
Steel cooperation would be "the best concept" for Thyssen workers and shareholders, the spokesman added.
Krupp would be able also to solve the problems at its Krupp Hoesch Stahl steel unit without harming Thyssen Stahl, the spokesman added.
